notes.title: Update 2.3: Dining car
notes.notes:
So, a major update has become available that adds:


 Dining car
 Achievement "Dining Car"
 Achievement "Investigator"
 The head of the train in a reserved seat carriage
 New dialogues in the dining car
 New sounds


Enjoy the game everyone!

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.notes:
Update 2.1 has been released, here is a list of all changes:

[olist]
 Increased the character's running speed by 70%
 Fixed a bug when people “fell” through the floor at a Moscow train station
 Added achievement "French Kiss"
 Fixed a bug where the player could turn on the TV while in another compartment
 Fixed the height of the player at the Kamyshlov station
 Added vegetation on the Moscow-Kazan route
 Fixed visual flares in the hospital
 Information notices and doctor signs have been added to the hospital
 In the hospital, the traumatologist now has his own office
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 2.0 is out!
notes.notes:
Friends, all these days we have been working on update 2.0, which has just been released!

Here's what was added:

[olist]
 New town and Kamyshlov station
 If you drink someone else's beer in a compartment car, the passenger will beat you up and you will end up in the hospital.
 New location - Hospital
 A new type of transport is a taxi, in which you will need to catch up with the train after getting to the hospital.
 New achievements: “Before Kamyshlov” and “Recovered”.
 New weather (thunderstorm with rain)
 New dialogues (Hospital)
 Various bug fixes
[/olist]
Work on adding content is ongoing. Write reviews!

notes.title: A new update under the index 2.0 is being developed: details
notes.notes:
Dear players, I am glad that you write reviews with wishes for future updates!

Now I would like to talk about a new major update that is being developed.
At the moment, it has been noticed that at the station in Moscow there are very few activities for players, since I focused on the atmosphere of the station area so that the player would feel and feel nostalgic, but this was not enough for most players.

Modeling is currently underway for a new train station that will allow you to walk inside. The station area will also change greatly, new objects, activities, dialogues, and achievements will be added. It is planned to create the same stations for other cities (Kazan, Yekaterinburg, Novosibirsk and Vladivostok). More cities may be added in the future.

Please have a little patience, with your help the game will become, although not ideal, quite good.

notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
Friends, a new, major update has been released right now. Here's what was added/changed:

 Added the city of Kazan
 Added achievement "Reached Kazan"
 The terrain through which the train travels has changed. Before Kazan there is much more forest, and after that there is more mountainous terrain.
 The schedule of train stops and departures has changed.
 Fixed a bug when dark artifacts were visible on some buildings in cities
 Walking speed increased by 5%
 Running speed increased by an additional 10%
 Increased the number of buildings near the station
 Now the player in his compartment can lie on the upper shelves
 The conductor at the carriage has been replaced (now the conductors at the station and in the player’s carriage are the same)

Please write about any errors or bugs you find in the discussions. It will be fixed quickly. Thank you!

notes.title: Game update: bug fixes
notes.notes:
Friends, thank you very much for your comments and reviews, where you write about the errors/bugs found and other shortcomings.

Over the course of 2 days, many small urgent updates were released, where critical errors were corrected.
Now an update has been released that fixes some bugs, namely:

[olist]
 Fixed a bug where the player could suddenly move vertically and the character would appear to be flying.
 Increased running speed by 15%.
 The dancing character was removed from the reserved seat car (as it turned out, he interfered with many people’s ability to move around the car)
 The key to the door of the reserved seat carriage was slightly moved to a more visible place (judging by your streams and video reviews, only 40% of all players were able to find the lost key)
 Fixed minor errors in text translations
[/olist]

notes.title: Urgent update
notes.notes:

Fixed. Please update the game.
